about: Tagout held-out cases, written Oct 25 2026 and committed before any arm ran on them. None of these recalls is in eval/cases.json or was used for any fix (the search, reading and matching code under lib/ was last changed Oct 15 20:28 IST; the only later change, on Oct 25, put Nemotron 3.5 Super VL first for label photos). Each line is what a household would type (or, for one case, a photo of the tag from the agency's own notice). Ground truth comes from the agency record or the notice text, checked by eval/verify-holdout.mjs, never from Tagout's output.

sets.database: Recalls already in an agency API that Tagout queries: CPSC recalls posted Oct 15 and Oct 22, openFDA enforcement records first reported Oct 14 (openFDA had no later report on Oct 25), and NHTSA campaigns received Oct 19 and Oct 21.
sets.lag: Recalls published Oct 16-22 that no database Tagout queries had on Oct 25: FDA company announcements with no openFDA report yet, and a USDA FSIS recall (Tagout has no FSIS database tool). Only the web search can find these; they test the window Tavily is there for.

forms.clean: One tidy line with the code after a keyword (model, lot, UPC), like the 105 tuned cases.
forms.messy: A typo, a synonym, lowercase, no keyword before the code, or a label-style string.
forms.photo: No text: one label photo taken from the agency notice's own images.

expect.danger: Red: the unit's code is printed in the recall.
expect.not-danger: Anything but red: the code is not in the recall it sits next to.
expect.warning: Orange: the product line is recalled but the line gives no code to confirm the unit (or a car NHTSA lists a recall for).
expect.flag: Orange or red, never green: the recall covers the line but limits it by dates or covers all units with no code to compare, so either tag is defensible; green would clear a recalled unit.
